_comment: Multi-object grid resize with NO mover: the canvas grows from 4x4 to a fixed 6x6 and every object stays at its own position, padded with background. No single object moves (object_motion declines: zero moved), outputs differ across pairs (constant_output declines), nothing is recoloured (object_recolor declines). Only the general Slow-path synthesizer solves it, by SEARCH over make_grid+coloring (schema 3: make_grid(fitted dims, bg) then paint every input object at its own cells/colour). Isolates the multi-object-reconstruction-onto-a-resized-canvas capability that no recognition family expresses.
